title: DOTS Updater
body:
I made an update utility for Disorder of the Stone! It's a Prism Launcher instance that installs the latest version of the modpack for you, and updates it when a new one comes out.

~ Niko

![image: The DOTS Updater](media/updater_screen.png)

Download it [here](https://github.com/noelledotjpg/DOTS-Updater/releases/) and import it into Prism Launcher (Add Instance → Import). Importing a newer version later replaces the old one.
